commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "PRODUCT_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo 'WAIT_FOR_HOST_LOAD_UNDER_14'
READY=0
for n in $(seq 1 24);do
  LOAD="$(python3 -c 'import os;print("%.1f"%os.getloadavg()[0])')"
  echo "LOAD_SAMPLE=$n:$LOAD"
  if python3 -c "raise SystemExit(0 if float('$LOAD') < 14 else 1)";then READY=1;break;fi
  sleep 10
done
if test "$READY" -ne 1;then echo HOST_OVERLOADED_NO_E2E_RUN;exit 43;fi
echo 'CANONICAL_VISUAL_E2E_START'
set +e
LCL_E2E_PORT=5296 LCL_VISUAL_CONTRACT=1 pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/mobile/playwright.config.ts --workers=1 --reporter=json >/tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-187-e2e.json 2>/tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-187-e2e.err
result=$?
set -e
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('/tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-187-e2e.json').read_text(errors='replace')
try:
 j=json.loads(s[s.find('{'):]);z=j.get('stats',{});print('E2E_STATS',z)
 def walk(ss):
  for x in ss:
   for spec in x.get('specs',[]):
    for t in spec.get('tests',[]):
     if t.get('status') not in ('expected','skipped'):
      print('FAILED',spec.get('title'),t.get('status'))
      for r in t.get('results',[]):
       if r.get('error'):print('ERROR',(r['error'].get('message') or '')[:1800])
   walk(x.get('suites',[]))
 walk(j.get('suites',[]))
except Exception as e:print('PARSE_ERROR',repr(e),s[-1300:])
PY
echo "E2E_EXIT=$result"
tail -15 /tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-187-e2e.err || true
git status --short
test "$result" -eq 0
